name: secondu-team-travel-plan
description: Verify destination conditions, budget and transport, then build an adjustable itinerary.

displayDescription.zh: 核对目的地条件、预算和交通，再将可靠信息组成可调整的行程。
displayDescription.en: Verify destination conditions, budget and transport, then build an adjustable itinerary.

quickPrompts.zh: 根据时间、预算和偏好，比较出行方案并给出行程和备选。
quickPrompts.en: Compare travel options within these dates, budget and preferences, then provide an itinerary and alternatives.

description.zh: 核实交通、时区、营业时间和预订条件，记录查询日期；未确定价格和规则显式标注。交付 sources.md。
description.en: Check transport, timezones, opening hours and booking conditions with lookup dates. Mark uncertain prices and rules. Deliver sources.md.

description.zh: 统一比较口径，保留原币、换算依据、税费与浮动范围；计算总额和缓冲，不进行购买。交付 budget.csv。
description.en: Compare costs consistently, retaining original currencies, conversion basis, taxes and uncertainty. Compute totals and buffers without purchases. Deliver budget.csv.

description.zh: 检查移动时间、休息、天气备选及不能同时满足的约束。交付逐日行程与准备清单，注明仍需确认的预订。
description.en: Check travel time, rest, alternatives and conflicting constraints. Deliver a daily itinerary and checklist with unconfirmed bookings clearly marked.
